4279-5931-6255--216.easyPrerequisites:
Funeral Room is unlocked.
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
4279-5931-6255--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Funeral Room, Zahur and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Funeral Room trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Zahur ability, creating a tapped 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Funeral Room triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

710-8095-8207.easyPrerequisites: Ferocity of the Hunt attached to Danitha.
710-8095-8207.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Danitha
When Danitha dies, Ferocity of the Hunt triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Ferocity of the Hunt from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

2586-3197-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Odric's Outrider triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability
Repeat

339-677-4247-4885.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

3899-6972-7155.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Arcbound Fiend.
When Arcbound Fiend dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Fiend's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Fiend from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to the creature with changeling

4082-4640-6797--201.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the creature with changeling.
When that creature dies, Oathkeeper triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When that creature enters, Kemba triggers, allowing you to attach Oathkeeper to that creature.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

1309-3617-7370.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost.
Kykar triggers, exiling Salvager of Secrets.
Resolve Time Walk, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Kykar triggers, returning Salvager of Secrets from exile to the battlefield.
When Salvager of Secrets enters, it triggers, returning Time Walk from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

4137-4644-7791.description:
Activate Blossom-Clad Werewolf by tapping it, adding two mana of any color
Activate Tidewater Minion by tapping it, targeting Blossom-Clad Werewolf.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Tidewater Minion's ability, targeting Tidewater Minion.
Resolve both Tidewater Minion abilities, untapping it and Blossom-Clad Werewolf.
Repeat.

215-1355-2079.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four enchantments.
215-1355-2079.description:
Activate Sanctum Weaver by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Sanctum Weaver from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Sanctum Weaver by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1563-3499-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
1563-3499-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
1563-3499-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

11-60.manaNeeded: {U}{U}{U/R}{U/R} plus enough mana to cast the additional instant or sorcery
11-60.easyPrerequisites: You have an additional instant or sorcery card in hand with mana value 4 or less and valid targets as applicable.
11-60.description:
Cast any instant or sorcery by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Expansion by paying its mana cost, targeting the instant or sorcery cast in step 1.
Cast Narset's Reversal by paying {U}{U}, copying Expansion targeting the spell cast in step 1 and returning the original Expansion to your hand.
Cast Expansion by paying its mana cost, copying the copy of Expansion, targeting the copy of Expansion.
Resolve the copy of Expansion, creating a copy of Expansion targeting the copy of Expansion.
Repeat step 5.

5073-5220-6900-7452.description:
Activate Tinder Wall by sacrificing it.
When Tinder Wall dies, Mortuary and Cauldron of Essence trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Tinder Wall from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Cauldron of Essence trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Cast Tinder Wall from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

240-4068-5147-5470.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain.
240-4068-5147-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target
Repeat from step 2.

1491-2113-4565-6218.description:
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Pheres-Band Tromper triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

4210-5670-6705.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 2.
You control at least one additional creature.
4210-5670-6705.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Wayward Disciple triggers if it's on the battlefield, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token and a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Pious Evangel triggers if it's on the battlefield, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Avatar Kuruk

5361-7009-7068.manaNeeded: {3}{U} plus {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn
5361-7009-7068.description:
Activate Auton Soldier using Avatar Kuruk's ability by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Baboon Spirit by paying {3}{U}, exiling Auton Soldier.
At the beginning of your end step, Baboon Spirit triggers, returning Auton Soldier from exile to the battlefield. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat each turn.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

2079-3259-6096.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2079-3259-6096.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and General Kreat as attackers.
General Kreat triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, General Kreat triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
2079-3259-6096.notes: After the first loop, General Kreat doesn't have to attack, since the Goblin token attacking will trigger it.

277-630-5702-5954.easyPrerequisites:
Springheart Nantuko attached to Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods does not have summoning sickness.
277-630-5702-5954.description:
Declare Overlord of the Hauntwoods as an attacker.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods triggers, creating a tapped Everywhere land token.
When the Everywhere token enters the battlefield, Tiller Engine and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Resolve the Tiller Engine trigger, untapping Everywhere.
Holding priority, activate Everywhere by tapping it, adding {G}.
Keeper of Progenitus triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When the Overlord of the Hauntwoods token enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a tapped Everywhere land token.
Repeat from step 3.

1434-1965-5642.manaNeeded: {2} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
1434-1965-5642.description:
Cast Omarthis either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2} plus commander tax, if applicable.
Echoes of Eternity triggers, copying the Omarthis spell.
Resolve the copy of the Omarthis spell, creating a token copy of Omarthis with one +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the original Omarthis spell, causing it to enter the battlefield with one +1/+1 counter on it.
The token Omarthis's first ability triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the token Omarthis.
The nontoken Omarthis's first ability triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the nontoken Omarthis.
Repeat from step 5.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control that does not have summoning sickness

1674-3259.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1674-3259.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Daring Piracy triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

814-2034-2751-4853.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least two Soldiers.
Myrel does not have summoning sickness.
814-2034-2751-4853.description:
Declare Myrel as an attacker, triggering its ability.
Holding priority, activate Strionic Resonator by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Myrel's ability.
Resolve the copy of Myrel's ability, creating at least two 1/1 Soldier artifact creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Soldier, adding {C}{C}.
When the Soldier dies, Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping Strionic Resonator.
Repeat from step 2.

1124-2858-4074-4554.description:
Activate Chandra, Torch of Defiance's second ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, adding {R}{R}.
Activate Chandra, Hope's Beacon's first ability by putting two loyalty counters on it, adding two mana of any color.
Activate The Chain Veil by paying {4} and tapping it, allowing you an additional activation of your planeswalkers' loyalty abilities this turn.
Activate Teferi's first ability by putting two loyalty counters on it, untapping The Chain Veil.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite loyalty counters on Teferi, you may also use its third loyalty ability each turn to take infinite turns.

546-1409-2646.notablePrerequisites:
Bloodspore Thrinax has at least five +1/+1 counters on it.
Deadeye Navigator is paired with Ramos.
546-1409-2646.description:
Activate Ramos by paying {1}{U}, blinking itself and causing it to enter with at least five +1/+1 counters on it due to Bloodspore Thrinax.
Ramos enters the battlefield, triggering Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability, repairing Deadeye Navigator and Ramos.
Activate Ramos by removing five +1/+1 counters from it, adding {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

1923-4050-4772.description:
Cast Summon the School for {3}{W}, creating four Merfolk creature tokens.
Activate Summon the School by tapping four untapped Merfolk, returning it to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Merfolk token, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat step 3 an additional three times.
Repeat.

147-4162-4191.easyPrerequisites: There are applicable target(s) for Depths of Desire.
147-4162-4191.description:
Cast Depths of Desire by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage without paying its mana cost due to Aluren.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Depths of Desire, targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Depths of Desire copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

57-232-1636.notablePrerequisites: Feldon does not have summoning sickness.
57-232-1636.description:
Activate Feldon by tapping it and paying {2}{R}, creating an artifact token copy of Priest of Urabrask with haste.
The token copy of Priest of Urabrask and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the Priest of Urabrask trigger, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

9-1308-1645-3581.description:
Cast Crown of Flames on Kykar, Wind's Fury.
Kykar Wind's Fury triggers creating 2 spirits with Anointed Procession.
Sacrifice both spirits adding {R}{R} to your mana pool with Kykar, Wind's Fury.
Return Crown of Flames to your hand with its ability.
Repeat for an arbitrarily large storm count.
Cast Grapeshot instead of Crown of Flames.
